strings.text: Everything on a bridal list has a history.
A Banarasi sari can take up to six months to weave.
strings.source: Wikipedia: Banarasi sari (15 days to a month, sometimes up to six months)

strings.text: Paithani saris were traded to the Roman world two thousand years ago.
strings.source: Wikipedia: Paithani (Satavahana period, 2nd c. BCE to 2nd c. CE; trade with Greco-Roman countries)

strings.text: The bridal garland is the varmala, the 'boon garland'.
Mehndi often hides the couple's initials in its pattern.
strings.source: Wikipedia: Mehndi (names or initials of bride and groom hidden within the design)

strings.text: In some traditions, a bride never buys her own bangles.
strings.source: Wikipedia: Bangle (tradition that a woman does not buy the bangles she will wear)

strings.text: The lehenga became popular in the sixteenth century.
